shortDescription: BitcoinTreasuries.NET said on X that premarket trading has opened and Strive's SATA is just 2 cents below par value. According to Odaily, SATA has raised enough funds this week to buy more than 500 Bitcoin, and Bitcoin accumulation is set to begin.
